test_overview: Evaluated the invite-only registration flow of the Flask Team Chat app (localhost:8000). Steps 1-4 fully passed: Alice generated two distinct single-use invite links (displayed as full URL text); a valid unused invite revealed the registration form with Username/Display name/Password fields and a Create Account action; all four validation errors (Username required, Display name required, Password required, Username already taken) rejected invalid submissions without consuming the invite; and a new user registered successfully via a valid invite, was auto-logged in, landed in #general, had display name 'New User' shown, and could send a message. Steps 5 and 6 failed ONLY on their non-fatal error-display checks: for a used invite and an invalid token, the registration form was correctly NOT shown (main verification passed), but NO error message was rendered indicating the invite is invalid/already used (the error element stayed empty/hidden). Per scoring rules, a non-fatal sub-verification failure still causes the step to receive 0 points. Total: 34/48.

steps.description: test_generate_invite_links: Alice logged in, landed in #general, clicked Invite New Member, obtained two distinct single-use invite links displayed as full URL text. Both URLs recorded and confirmed different.

test_valid_invite_shows_registration_form: Navigating to a valid unused invite (logged out) revealed the registration form after the async invite check, with Username, Display name, and Password fields plus a visible 'Create Account' submit button.

test_registration_validation_errors_do_not_consume_invite: All four invalid submissions rejected (not logged in, stayed on register page) with correct exact error messages. After all failures the invite was not consumed - the form still appeared on re-navigation.

test_successful_registration_consumes_invite: Registered newuser/New User/newpass123 via valid invite; registration succeeded, auto-logged in, navigated to #general, display name 'New User' shown in UI, and a message was sent and appeared in #general.

test_used_invite_cannot_be_reused: For the used invite the registration form was correctly NOT shown, but NO error message was displayed indicating the invite is invalid/already used (error element empty). Non-fatal sub-verification failed -> step 0 points.

test_invalid_token_rejected: For a fabricated invalid-token URL the registration form was correctly NOT shown, but NO error message was displayed indicating the invite is invalid (error element empty). Non-fatal sub-verification failed -> step 0 points.
